subject: Purchase follow-up: missing attachment
text:
Professor,

I am following up on the purchase of the lab notebook, safety goggles, and specimen set I ordered through the department supply form last week. The payment posted to my student account, and the order confirmation said pickup would be available at the science annex within two business days. I checked this morning, but no invoice arrived with the confirmation email, so I cannot verify the cost or the expected pickup window. Please confirm whether the purchase was completed and send the missing attachment. I need the documentation for my adviser's semester expense form, and she cannot approve reimbursement without a dated receipt and itemized totals. If the order has already been processed, a brief confirmation would help, even if the attachment is unavailable. If there was a billing error or a missing form, please tell me what corrective step I should take. I can provide the order number, payment confirmation screenshot, or card reference. I would appreciate an update today because my group starts the experiment Friday. If another staff member handles supplies, please pass this along and let me know who to contact. I can stop by during office hours if that is faster, but I wanted to leave a record in case the attachment is lost. I checked spam, the portal, and my personal payment records, and none include the invoice. If the department sends receipts only on request, please submit it with the current billing cycle so the records match.

Thanks,
